𝗪𝗛𝗘𝗘𝗟𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗜𝗥 𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗘𝗣! 🇮🇳

India beat Sri Lanka 2-0 in the wheelchair T20I series in Chennai.
Sri Lanka were bowled out for 62; India chased it at 65/3 in the 10th over.

Proud of this team 👏

#WheelchairCricket #Cricket

👉 India ne Sri Lanka ko wheelchair T20I series 2-0 se haraya (Chennai)
👉 Sri Lanka sirf 62 par all out
👉 India ne target 65/3 banakar 10th over mein chase kiya
👉 Series ke aakhri din baarish ki wajah se khel nahi ho paya

In champions ko bhi utna hi support milna chahiye. Aap kitna follow karte ho wheelchair cricket? Comment karo 👇
